Subject: Quick follow-up + next step: Private VPC architecture review

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about FinCo's planned workload (high-throughput inference, regulated PII processing, and strict egress rules). Per our discussion, the next best step is a focused architecture review (Private/VPC) with your cloud/networking engineer to validate networking, IAM, and data flow requirements.

Proposed outcomes for the call:
- Confirm VPC connectivity options (VPC peering vs. Private Service Connect / Transit)
- Review required egress/firewall rules and NAT design
- Discuss KMS/HSM integration and key custody model
- Identify data residency and audit logging requirements

I have a few time slots next week — can you share what works for you and your IT lead?
- Tue 2028-03-14: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2028-03-15: 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 2028-03-16: 08:00–09:00 PT

I've attached a short "Private VPC questionnaire" to help your team prep (network CIDR, proxy/NAT details, preferred KMS). If you prefer, we can run a shorter 30-minute alignment first and expand into a deeper technical session.

Attachments: [Attachment: private-vpc-questionnaire.pdf (PDF)]

Next steps: if one of the slots works, I'll send a calendar invite and a proposed agenda.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
